decision: Reverted: no useful physical typing latency improvement established.
method: Serial ordinary source-mode Desktop journeys in the existing checkout. Same native binary, physical X11 sink and unchanged resource guards. Every previous-source run restores main. CPU observer active only for the isolated character in paired runs; grouping diagnostics add read-only sampling through the burst and are kept separate.
limitations: Shared-host timing varies; the few paired runs do not establish a confidence interval.
No input is withheld to form a batch. At 5 Hz, backlog comes from existing publication/ACK latency.
Native step deltas use observations near frame boundaries and include intervening guest work and idle loops; they are not exact paint-only costs.

Grouping samples are read after existing owner boundaries. All 19 distinct consecutive characters were observed, but this technique cannot distinguish adjacent identical keys or every sub-boundary event.

fixed-lr88ypce.method: Read-only sampling after existing owner boundaries from first text request until shutdown. An event change may be observed partway through a dispatch; sampling can miss a very cheap event. Adjacent identical events cannot be distinguished. No guest writes or boundary changes.

fixed-8optsw0w.method: Read-only sampling after existing owner boundaries from first text request until shutdown. An event change may be observed partway through a dispatch; sampling can miss a very cheap event. Adjacent identical events cannot be distinguished. No guest writes or boundary changes.

supervisor.note: Outer watchdog includes image packaging and is no larger than the canonical budget.

profile.method: SIGUSR1 before first send_text; SIGUSR2 at first subsequent complete-offer observation. Interval starts and stops on existing owner boundaries. Signal delivery can add idle boundaries; native counters freeze at stop. Physical trace includes this observer and is a paired diagnostic, not an unprofiled benchmark.
